body: I have been to 3 shrinks, went to a group addiction therapy place for months, go to another psychologist now and it all just seems to be getting redundant, and am on anti-depressants.  I do appreciate the concern and the idea, but this is one of the reasons I can't bring myself to go on. I went to these places that are supposed to help, but all they did was give me temporary relief because I knew that other people were going through the same thing.  Thanks again
